title: Technical Project
description: Provides an opportunity to carry out a design or research project of a technical level similar to 4th year electives, under the supervision of a faculty member. Requires independent study of current technical literature. When feasible, the design should be assessed in the laboratory. A complete report must be presented at the end of the term.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 499, BME 490, BME 498, CIVE 499, MECH 497, MECH 498.
